payload.prompt: Which statements correctly describe OCR and document analysis?

options.text: OCR identifies where text appears in an image
options.rationale: OCR is a computer vision technology that identifies the location of text in an image. This is the first part of many document analysis solutions.

options.text: Analytical models can interpret extracted values
options.rationale: OCR is often combined with an analytical model. The model can interpret individual values and extract fields, such as matching receipt text to expense claim fields.

options.text: OCR is mainly for blocking harmful content
options.error_type: confuses OCR with responsible AI guardrails
options.rationale: Blocking harmful content is handled by responsible guardrails such as content filters. OCR is for locating text in images.
options.better_fit: Choose content filters when the concern is harmful, illegal, or offensive generated content.

feedback.intrinsic: A learner might choose the wrong approach for scanned forms and receipts.
feedback.instructional: Keep the roles separate: OCR finds image text, while guardrails reduce harmful content risk.

options.text: OCR turns spoken audio into text
options.error_type: confuses OCR with speech-to-text recognition
options.rationale: Speech recognition turns spoken audio into text. OCR locates text that appears inside images.
options.better_fit: Choose speech recognition when audio needs to be transcribed into text.

feedback.intrinsic: Audio work and image-text work would be mixed up.
feedback.instructional: Use speech recognition for spoken words; use OCR for text visible in images.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. OCR locates text in images, and analytical models can interpret values for fields.

payload.prompt: Which tasks are information extraction scenarios?

options.text: Extract serial numbers from component images
options.rationale: Information extraction can find text such as serial numbers in images. This can help identify the source computer or component.

options.text: Identify follow-up actions from meeting recordings
options.rationale: Information extraction can identify key points and follow-up actions from meeting transcripts or recordings. This fits the task exactly.

options.text: Generate human-like spoken voices
options.error_type: confuses extraction with speech synthesis
options.rationale: Generating spoken voices is speech synthesis. Information extraction is about finding data and insights in sources such as forms, images, and recordings.
options.better_fit: Choose speech synthesis when text needs to become audible spoken language.

feedback.intrinsic: The team would produce speech instead of finding useful data or actions.
feedback.instructional: Speech synthesis vocalizes words; extraction pulls information from sources.

options.text: Predict an image label from training data
options.error_type: confuses extraction scenarios with image classification
options.rationale: Predicting an image label is image classification. Information extraction focuses on finding specific information, such as serial numbers or follow-up actions.
options.better_fit: Choose image classification when the goal is to identify the main subject of an image.

feedback.intrinsic: The result would be a label, not the specific values or follow-up actions needed.
feedback.instructional: Image classification names the main subject; information extraction pulls targeted details from content.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Information extraction can work with component images and meeting recordings to find useful details.

payload.prompt: Which uses fit computer vision?

options.text: Robotics and self-driving vehicles
options.rationale: Robotics and self-driving vehicles use visual input to understand surroundings. They are listed computer vision scenarios.

options.text: Redacting private details in text

options.rationale: Redacting private details in text is a specialized form of entity detection. It belongs to natural language processing, which makes sense of language.

feedback.intrinsic: A visual approach would be chosen for a language-processing task.
feedback.instructional: Computer vision analyzes visual input; redacting private details in writing uses text analysis.

options.text: Detecting the language of a document
options.error_type: confuses visual input with language detection
options.rationale: Language detection determines which language a body of text is written in. It is a natural language processing technique, not a computer vision scenario.
options.better_fit: Choose this when processing text written in one or more languages.

feedback.intrinsic: The task would be placed in the wrong category.
feedback.instructional: Language detection works with written language; computer vision works with photos, videos, and camera feeds.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Visual search, robotics, and self-driving vehicles all use visual input.

payload.prompt: Which statements describe responsible AI?

options.text: It reduces risk from harmful automated actions
options.rationale: Responsible AI includes guardrails to reduce the risk of harmful automated actions. It also addresses harmful, illegal, or offensive content generation.

options.text: It should be considered during operation
options.rationale: Responsible AI must be considered from conception through operation. It is not finished after design or implementation.

options.text: It is only needed for image models
options.error_type: confuses responsible AI scope with computer vision only
options.rationale: Responsible AI applies to AI systems broadly, not only to image models. Its principles include fairness, safety, privacy, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability.
options.better_fit: Computer vision is only one area; responsible practice applies across many kinds of AI work.

feedback.intrinsic: Risks in chatbots, speech-based agents, and automated decisions could be ignored.
feedback.instructional: Responsible AI is broader than computer vision because harmful content and risky actions can appear in many AI uses.

options.text: It replaces the need for privacy principles
options.error_type: confuses guardrails with ignoring responsible AI principles
options.rationale: Privacy and security is one of the responsible AI principles. Responsible AI includes privacy protection; it does not replace it.
options.better_fit: Use privacy and security when protecting training data and private personal or organizational details.

feedback.intrinsic: Private details could be exposed or mishandled.
feedback.instructional: Privacy and security are part of responsible AI, so they must be included rather than replaced.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Responsible AI reduces risk and must continue into operation.

feedback.instructional: Facial recognition is a computer vision scenario for authentication; OCR is the right match for text inside images.

options.text: Security video monitoring
options.error_type: confuses document extraction with another computer vision scenario

options.better_fit: Choose this when the task is monitoring security video.

feedback.intrinsic: The receipts would not be converted into usable claim information.
feedback.instructional: Video monitoring is a visual scenario, but receipt processing needs OCR and field analysis.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. OCR finds text in receipt images, and analysis can connect those values to expense claim fields.

payload.prompt: A robotics engineer tests a robot that uses computer vision. The robot sees an object, but its confidence, meaning certainty, is below the set threshold. What is the best decision?

options.error_type: confuses one guardrail with the full responsible AI lifecycle
options.rationale: Filters can help, but responsible AI is not limited to filters after launch. It should be considered from conception through design, implementation, and operation.
options.better_fit: Filters fit as one safeguard, especially for harmful generated content, but they should not be the whole plan.

feedback.intrinsic: Risky actions and harmful content could be missed because planning started too late and too narrowly.
feedback.instructional: Responsible guardrails work across the full lifecycle, with filters as only one part.

options.text: Treat OCR as the main safeguard
options.error_type: confuses document analysis with responsible AI guardrails
options.rationale: OCR locates text in images. It is not a safeguard for harmful generated content or risky automated actions.
options.better_fit: Choose OCR for scanned images where text must be located and interpreted.

feedback.intrinsic: The safety lead would focus on reading image text instead of reducing harmful behavior.
feedback.instructional: OCR supports extraction from images; guardrails reduce harmful content and risky actions.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Responsible guardrails include early risk planning and filters for harmful content.

payload.prompt: A project manager reviews an AI system before release. The manager must check that responsible AI principles are being applied. Which checks belong?

options.text: Test for fairness and bias
options.rationale: Fairness includes minimizing bias in training data and testing solutions for fairness. This check directly supports a responsible AI principle.

options.text: Explain system limits to users
options.rationale: Transparency includes making users aware of how a solution works and any limitations it may have. Explaining limits supports that principle.

options.text: Keep training data secure
options.rationale: Privacy and security include keeping training data secure. They also include preventing trained models from revealing private personal or organizational details.

options.text: Extract serial numbers from photos
options.error_type: confuses responsible AI principles with information extraction
options.rationale: Extracting serial numbers from photos is an information extraction scenario. It does not check fairness, transparency, or privacy practice before release.
options.better_fit: Choose this when the goal is to find data such as serial numbers in images.

feedback.intrinsic: The release review could miss fairness, privacy, or transparency gaps.
feedback.instructional: Serial-number extraction is a capability; responsible principles are checks for how solutions are built, explained, protected, and governed.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Fairness, transparency, and privacy and security are all responsible AI principles.

flashcards.back: OCR identifies the location of text in an image.
To reduce risk of harmful content generation.
Making users aware of how AI works and its limits.
Avoid action until confidence reaches the threshold.
